const PHOTO_THUMBS={"wood:oak":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","wood:smoke":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","wood:walnut":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","stone:viola":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","stone:carrara":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","stone:porc":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","stone:marq":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","stone:trav":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","tile:conc":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","tile:bath":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","fabric:linen":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","fabric:leather":"data:image/jpeg;base64,"};
const photoLoader=new THREE.TextureLoader();
function photoTexture(name,channel){
 const entry=PHOTO_FILES[name];if(!entry)return null;
 const t=photoLoader.load(entry[channel],undefined,undefined,(e)=>console.warn('Textura no disponible',name,channel,e));
 t.wrapS=t.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;t.anisotropy=ANISO;
 t.minFilter=THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
 if(channel==='albedo')t.encoding=THREE.sRGBEncoding;
 return t;
}
function tex(name){
 if(!TX[name]){
  const t=photoTexture(name,'albedo')||new THREE.CanvasTexture(texCanvas(name));
  t.wrapS=t.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;t.anisotropy=ANISO;t.encoding=THREE.sRGBEncoding;TX[name]=t;
 }
 return TX[name];
}
function bumpTex(kind,rep){const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(noiseCanvas(256,kind));t.wrapS=t.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;t.repeat.set(rep,rep);t.anisotropy=4;return t}
/* Superficies PBR: mapas de normales independientes del albedo y variación de rugosidad.
   Se generan una sola vez a 512 px y se conservan en caché (sin internet). */
const PBR={};
function surfaceMaps(name){
 if(PBR[name])return PBR[name];
 if(PHOTO_FILES[name])return PBR[name]={normal:photoTexture(name,'normal'),roughness:photoTexture(name,'roughness')};
 const sz=512,source=mk(sz,sz),sg=source.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
 sg.drawImage(texCanvas(name),0,0,sz,sz);
 const px=sg.getImageData(0,0,sz,sz).data,normal=mk(sz,sz),rough=mk(sz,sz);
 const ni=normal.getContext('2d').createImageData(sz,sz),ri=rough.getContext('2d').createImageData(sz,sz);
 const lum=new Float32Array(sz*sz),wood=name.startsWith('wood:'),tile=name.startsWith('tile:');
 const gain=wood?1.55:tile?2.9:1.15;
 for(let i=0;i<lum.length;i++)lum[i]=px[i*4]*.2126+px[i*4+1]*.7152+px[i*4+2]*.0722;
 for(let y=0;y<sz;y++)for(let x=0;x<sz;x++){
  const i=y*sz+x,i4=i*4;
  const l=lum[y*sz+(x+sz-1)%sz],r=lum[y*sz+(x+1)%sz],
    u=lum[((y+sz-1)%sz)*sz+x],d=lum[((y+1)%sz)*sz+x];
  const nx=(l-r)*gain/255,ny=(u-d)*gain/255,zz=1/Math.sqrt(nx*nx+ny*ny+1);
  ni.data[i4]=clamp((nx*zz*.5+.5)*255,0,255);
  ni.data[i4+1]=clamp((ny*zz*.5+.5)*255,0,255);
  ni.data[i4+2]=clamp((zz*.5+.5)*255,0,255);ni.data[i4+3]=255;
  const grain=(Math.sin(x*1.71+y*2.13)*Math.sin(y*.73-x*2.19))*.5+.5;
  const v=wood?204+grain*40:tile?225+grain*22:198+grain*35;
  ri.data[i4]=ri.data[i4+1]=ri.data[i4+2]=v;ri.data[i4+3]=255;
 }
 normal.getContext('2d').putImageData(ni,0,0);
 rough.getContext('2d').putImageData(ri,0,0);
 const nt=new THREE.CanvasTexture(normal),rt=new THREE.CanvasTexture(rough);
 for(const t of[nt,rt]){t.wrapS=t.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;t.anisotropy=Math.min(8,ANISO);t.minFilter=THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;t.generateMipmaps=true}
 return PBR[name]={normal:nt,roughness:rt};
}
function uvScale(g,su,sv){const u=g.attributes.uv;for(let i=0;i<u.count;i++)u.setXY(i,u.getX(i)*su,u.getY(i)*sv);u.needsUpdate=true}
function boxUV(g,m){const p=g.attributes.position,n=g.attributes.normal,u=g.attributes.uv;
 for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){const ax=Math.abs(n.getX(i)),ay=Math.abs(n.getY(i)),az=Math.abs(n.getZ(i));let a,b;
  if(ax>=ay&&ax>=az){a=p.getZ(i);b=p.getY(i)}else if(ay>=az){a=p.getX(i);b=p.getZ(i)}else{a=p.getX(i);b=p.getY(i)}u.setXY(i,a/m,b/m)}u.needsUpdate=true}
function applyTex(m,name,r,bump){const maps=surfaceMaps(name);m.map=tex(name);m.bumpMap=null;m.normalMap=maps.normal;m.normalScale.set((bump||.08)*2,(bump||.08)*2);m.roughnessMap=maps.roughness;m.roughness=r;m.color.set(0xffffff);m.needsUpdate=true}
function applyCol(m,c,r){m.map=m.baseMap||null;m.bumpMap=m.baseBumpMap||null;m.normalMap=m.baseNormalMap||null;m.roughnessMap=m.baseRoughnessMap||null;if(m.baseNormalScale&&m.normalScale)m.normalScale.copy(m.baseNormalScale);m.color.set(c);m.roughness=r;m.needsUpdate=true}
/* Caja redondeada con normales analíticas (suave, sin dependencias) */
function rbox(w,h,d,r,seg){
 seg=seg||8;const g=new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,d,seg,seg,seg),p=g.attributes.position,n=g.attributes.normal,H=[w/2,h/2,d/2];
 r=Math.min(r,H[0]*.98,H[1]*.98,H[2]*.98);const a=.5;
 const f=(u,hh)=>{const m=Math.abs(u)/hh,s=u<0?-1:1;return s*(m<=a?(m/a)*(hh-r):(hh-r)+((m-a)/(1-a))*r)};
 for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){
  const q=[f(p.getX(i),H[0]),f(p.getY(i),H[1]),f(p.getZ(i),H[2])],dd=[0,0,0];let len=0;
  for(let k=0;k<3;k++){const lim=H[k]-r,inn=clamp(q[k],-lim,lim);dd[k]=q[k]-inn;q[k]=inn;len+=dd[k]*dd[k]}
  len=Math.sqrt(len)||1;
  for(let k=0;k<3;k++)dd[k]/=len;
  p.setXYZ(i,q[0]+dd[0]*r,q[1]+dd[1]*r,q[2]+dd[2]*r);n.setXYZ(i,dd[0],dd[1],dd[2]);
 }
 return g;
}

}

function wall(ax,fixed,s0,s1,th,mat,holes,o){
 o=o||{};holes=(holes||[]).slice().sort((p,q)=>p.a-q.a);let cur=s0;const grp=o.group||scene;
 const piece=(a,b,y0,y1,col)=>{if(b-a<1e-3||y1-y0<1e-3)return;const len=b-a,hh=y1-y0,
   m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(ax==='x'?len:th,hh,ax==='x'?th:len),mat);
   m.position.set(ax==='x'?(a+b)/2:fixed,(y0+y1)/2,ax==='x'?fixed:(a+b)/2);m.castShadow=!o.thin;m.receiveShadow=true;grp.add(m);
   if(col&&!o.thin){const c=ax==='x'?{x0:a,x1:b,z0:fixed-th/2,z1:fixed+th/2}:{x0:fixed-th/2,x1:fixed+th/2,z0:a,z1:b};(o.dyn||COL).push(c)}};
 for(const h of holes){piece(cur,h.a,0,H,true);piece(h.a,h.b,0,h.y0,!h.door);piece(h.a,h.b,h.y1,H,false);
  if(!h.door&&h.y0>0&&!o.thin)(o.dyn||COL).push(ax==='x'?{x0:h.a,x1:h.b,z0:fixed-th/2,z1:fixed+th/2}:{x0:fixed-th/2,x1:fixed+th/2,z0:h.a,z1:h.b});
  cur=h.b}
 piece(cur,s1,0,H,true);
}
function glazing(ax,fixed,a,b,y0,y1,mull,o){

 const bar=(la,lb,ya,yb)=>{const m=box(ax==='x'?lb-la:.06,yb-ya,ax==='x'?.06:lb-la,mBlack,ax==='x'?(la+lb)/2:fixed,(ya+yb)/2,ax==='x'?fixed:(la+lb)/2);m.castShadow=false;grp.add(m)};
 bar(a,b,y1-fw,y1);bar(a,b,y0,y0+fw);bar(a,a+fw,y0,y1);bar(b-fw,b,y0,y1);
 for(const c of(mull||[]))bar(c-fw/2,c+fw/2,y0,y1);
}

let envRT=null,lastEnv=null;const pmrem=webglOK?new THREE.PMREMGenerator(renderer):null;
function buildEnv(T){
 if(!webglOK||!pmrem||lastEnv===T||ST.quality==='fast')return;
 const es=new THREE.Scene(),geo=new THREE.SphereGeometry(50,32,16),pos=geo.attributes.position,col=new Float32Array(pos.count*3),
  top=new THREE.Color(T.top),hor=new THREE.Color(T.hor),gnd=new THREE.Color(T.gnd[0],T.gnd[1],T.gnd[2]),c=new THREE.Color();
 for(let i=0;i<pos.count;i++){const t=pos.getY(i)/50;if(t>=0)c.copy(hor).lerp(top,Math.pow(t,.6));else c.copy(hor).lerp(gnd,Math.min(1,-t*3));col.set([c.r,c.g,c.b],i*3)}
 geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(col,3));
 es.add(new THREE.Mesh(geo,new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({vertexColors:true,side:THREE.BackSide})));
 const sunc=new THREE.Color(T.sc).multiplyScalar(T.si>1?5:.6),p=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(26,18),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:sunc,side:THREE.DoubleSide}));
 p.position.set(T.sp[0]*.9,T.sp[1]*.7+6,T.sp[2]*.9);p.lookAt(0,0,0);es.add(p);
 const rt=pmrem.fromScene(es,.02);if(envRT)envRT.dispose();envRT=rt;scene.environment=rt.texture;lastEnv=T;
}

function tube(points,r,mat,segments=20){return mesh(new THREE.TubeGeometry(new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points.map(p=>new THREE.Vector3(...p))),segments,r,6,false),mat,0,0,0)}
// Cojines volumétricos: superelipsoide continuo, irregularidades de relleno y costura perimetral.
function softGeometry(w,h,d,power=.55,wrinkle=.018){
 const geo=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,64,40),p=geo.attributes.position,n=geo.attributes.normal;
 const sp=(v,e)=>Math.sign(v)*Math.pow(Math.abs(v),e),a=w/2,b=h/2,c=d/2;
 for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){
  const x=p.getX(i),y=p.getY(i),z=p.getZ(i);
  const wave=1+wrinkle*(Math.sin(16*x+4*z)*Math.cos(9*z+5*y)+.35*Math.cos(24*z-3*x))*Math.pow(1-Math.abs(y),.5);
  const X=sp(x,power)*a*wave,Y=sp(y,power)*b*wave,Z=sp(z,power)*c*wave;
  p.setXYZ(i,X,Y,Z);
  const e=2/power-1,nn=new THREE.Vector3(sp(X/a,e)/a,sp(Y/b,e)/b,sp(Z/c,e)/c).normalize();n.setXYZ(i,nn.x,nn.y,nn.z);
 }
 p.needsUpdate=n.needsUpdate=true;geo.computeBoundingSphere();return geo;
}
function seamLoop(w,d,y,mat,r=.0035){const pts=[];for(let i=0;i<=64;i++){const t=i*Math.PI*2/64,sg=v=>Math.sign(v)*Math.pow(Math.abs(v),.55);pts.push([sg(Math.cos(t))*w/2,y,sg(Math.sin(t))*d/2]);}const line=tube(pts,r,mat,80);line.castShadow=false;return line;}

function cushion(g,w,h,d,x,y,z,mat=mSofa){
 const part=new THREE.Group();part.position.set(x,y,z);g.add(part);
 const e=mesh(softGeometry(w,h,d,.45,.012),mat,0,0,0);part.add(e);
 if(h>d*1.2||h>w*1.2){const s= h>w?seamLoop(h*.98,d*.98,0,mat,.0025):seamLoop(w*.98,h*.98,0,mat,.0025);if(h>w)s.rotation.z=Math.PI/2;else s.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;part.add(s);}else part.add(seamLoop(w*.98,d*.98,0,mat,.0025));return part;
}

// Malla de ropa de cama continua: caída por los tres lados libres, con pliegues.
function drapedCover(w,d){const geo=new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1,1,72,56),p=geo.attributes.position;
 for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){const u=p.getX(i)*2,v=p.getY(i)*2,edge=Math.max(0,(Math.abs(u)-.88)/.12),foot=Math.max(0,(-v-.78)/.22),drop=Math.max(edge,foot);const fold=.012*Math.sin(u*31+v*3)+.008*Math.sin(v*19-u*4);
 p.setXYZ(i,u*w/2,.018*Math.cos(u*3)*Math.cos(v*2)+fold*(.4+drop*.6)-.23*Math.pow(drop,1.5),-v*d/2);}
 // Orientación: el extremo con caída corresponde al pie de la cama.
 geo.rotateY(Math.PI);geo.computeVertexNormals();geo.computeBoundingSphere();return geo;}

function planter(g,x,z,scale=1){
 const p=new THREE.Group();p.position.set(x,0,z);p.scale.setScalar(scale);g.add(p);
 p.add(mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.18,.15,.42,24),mCeramic,0,.22,0));

 const leafGeo=new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1,1,12,24),lp=leafGeo.attributes.position,lu=leafGeo.attributes.uv;
 for(let i=0;i<lp.count;i++){const u=lp.getX(i)*2,v=lp.getY(i)+.5;const width=.15*Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI*v),.8);lp.setXYZ(i,u*width,v*.52,.075*Math.sin(Math.PI*v)-.09*v*v-.038*u*u*Math.sin(Math.PI*v));lu.setXY(i,(u+1)/2,v)}
 leafGeo.computeVertexNormals();leafGeo.computeBoundingSphere();
 const r=rnd(169+Math.round(x*19+z*7));
 for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
  const a=i*2.39996,level=.65+(i%9)*.13,len=.36+.28*r();
  const leaf=mesh(leafGeo,i%3?mLeafA:mLeafB,Math.cos(a)*(.20+.24*r()),level,Math.sin(a)*(.20+.24*r()));
  leaf.rotation.set(.45+r()*.32,-a,.15+(r()-.5)*.6);leaf.scale.setScalar(len*1.65);leaf.castShadow=i%3===0;p.add(leaf);
 }
 return p;
}

/* ===== V9: oclusión ambiental en espacio de pantalla (SSAO) =====
   No es iluminación global. Se conserva el render directo en Rápida o si no hay WebGL2. */
let photoAO=null,aoDisabled=false;
function makeAO(){
 const target=new THREE.WebGLRenderTarget(1,1,{minFilter:THREE.LinearFilter,magFilter:THREE.LinearFilter,format:THREE.RGBAFormat,depthBuffer:true,stencilBuffer:false});
 target.texture.encoding=THREE.LinearEncoding;
 target.depthTexture=new THREE.DepthTexture(1,1,THREE.UnsignedIntType);
 target.depthTexture.minFilter=target.depthTexture.magFilter=THREE.NearestFilter;
 const uniforms={colorTex:{value:target.texture},depthTex:{value:target.depthTexture},invProjection:{value:new THREE.Matrix4()},projection:{value:new THREE.Matrix4()},texel:{value:new THREE.Vector2()},strength:{value:.65},radius:{value:.32},sampleCount:{value:8}};
 const material=new THREE.ShaderMaterial({uniforms,depthTest:false,depthWrite:false,toneMapped:false,
 vertexShader:`varying vec2 uv0; void main(){uv0=uv;gl_Position=vec4(position.xy,0.,1.);}`,
 fragmentShader:`precision highp float;
 varying vec2 uv0;uniform sampler2D colorTex,depthTex;uniform mat4 invProjection,projection;uniform vec2 texel;uniform float strength,radius;uniform int sampleCount;
 vec3 viewPos(vec2 uv,float d){vec4 p=invProjection*vec4(uv*2.-1.,d*2.-1.,1.);return p.xyz/p.w;}
 float depthAt(vec2 uv){return texture2D(depthTex,clamp(uv,vec2(0.001),vec2(.999))).r;}
 vec3 srgb(vec3 c){return mix(12.92*c,1.055*pow(max(c,vec3(0.)),vec3(1./2.4))-.055,step(vec3(.0031308),c));}
 void main(){
 vec3 color=texture2D(colorTex,uv0).rgb;float d=depthAt(uv0);if(d>=.99995){gl_FragColor=vec4(srgb(color),1.);return;}
 vec3 p=viewPos(uv0,d);vec2 dx=vec2(texel.x,0.),dy=vec2(0.,texel.y);
 vec3 l=p-viewPos(uv0-dx,depthAt(uv0-dx)),r=viewPos(uv0+dx,depthAt(uv0+dx))-p;
 vec3 b=p-viewPos(uv0-dy,depthAt(uv0-dy)),t=viewPos(uv0+dy,depthAt(uv0+dy))-p;
 vec3 nn=cross(abs(l.z)<abs(r.z)?l:r,abs(b.z)<abs(t.z)?b:t);vec3 n=length(nn)>.00000001?normalize(nn):vec3(0.,0.,1.);if(dot(n,-p)<0.)n=-n;
 float z=max(-p.z,.15);vec2 rad=vec2(projection[0][0],projection[1][1])*radius/(2.*z);
 rad=min(rad,vec2(.13));float acc=0.,weights=0.;
 for(int i=0;i<16;i++){if(i>=sampleCount)break;float k=float(i);float a=k*2.39996323;float f=sqrt((k+.5)/float(sampleCount));vec2 uv=uv0+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*rad*f;
 if(uv.x<=0.||uv.x>=1.||uv.y<=0.||uv.y>=1.)continue;float sd=depthAt(uv);if(sd>=.99995)continue;
 vec3 delta=viewPos(uv,sd)-p;float len=length(delta);float w=1.-smoothstep(radius*.12,radius,len);float facing=max(0.,dot(n,delta/max(len,.0001))-.10);
 acc+=w*facing;weights+=1.;}
 float ao=1.-clamp(acc/max(weights,1.)*strength*2.3,0.,.42);gl_FragColor=vec4(srgb(color*ao),1.);
 }`});
 const postScene=new THREE.Scene(),quad=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2,2),material);quad.frustumCulled=false;postScene.add(quad);
 return {target,uniforms,material,postScene,camera:new THREE.Camera()};
}
/* V10: reflexión planar de la escena. Una sola cámara auxiliar, solo cerca del baño.
   La cara reflectante se oculta al capturar, para impedir recursión. */
let planar=null,mirrorFailed=false,photoBusy=false;
function updatePlanarReflection(force=false){
 const face=scene.getObjectByName('planarMirror');if(!face||!webglOK)return;
 if((ST.quality==='fast'&&!force)||mirrorFailed||cam.position.x<=1.49||cam.position.z<3.1){face.material=mMirror;return;}
 const center=new THREE.Vector3(1.471,1.5,5.2),normal=new THREE.Vector3(1,0,0);
 const direction=cam.getWorldDirection(new THREE.Vector3());if(direction.dot(center.clone().sub(cam.position))<=0){face.material=mMirror;return;}
 const previous=renderer.getRenderTarget(),planes=renderer.clippingPlanes;
 try{
  if(!planar){
   const target=new THREE.WebGLRenderTarget(1,1,{minFilter:THREE.LinearFilter,magFilter:THREE.LinearFilter,depthBuffer:true});target.texture.encoding=THREE.LinearEncoding;
   const matrix=new THREE.Matrix4();
   const material=new THREE.ShaderMaterial({uniforms:{image:{value:target.texture},projector:{value:matrix}},toneMapped:false,
    vertexShader:`uniform mat4 projector; varying vec4 ray;void main(){vec4 p=modelMatrix*vec4(position,1.);ray=projector*p;gl_Position=projectionMatrix*viewMatrix*p;}`,
    fragmentShader:`uniform sampler2D image;varying vec4 ray;void main(){vec2 uv=ray.xy/ray.w;gl_FragColor=vec4(texture2D(image,clamp(uv,0.,1.)).rgb*.94,1.);
#include <encodings_fragment>
}`});
   planar={target,matrix,material,camera:new THREE.PerspectiveCamera()};
  }
  const r=planar,virtual=r.camera,w=Math.min(force?1280:768,canvas.width),h=Math.max(1,Math.round(w*canvas.height/canvas.width));
  if(r.target.width!==w||r.target.height!==h)r.target.setSize(w,h);
  cam.updateMatrixWorld();virtual.copy(cam,false);virtual.position.copy(cam.position).addScaledVector(normal,-2*(cam.position.x-center.x));
  const reflected=direction.clone().reflect(normal),up=new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0).applyQuaternion(cam.quaternion).reflect(normal);
  virtual.up.copy(up);virtual.lookAt(virtual.position.clone().add(reflected));virtual.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  r.matrix.set(.5,0,0,.5,0,.5,0,.5,0,0,.5,.5,0,0,0,1).multiply(virtual.projectionMatrix).multiply(virtual.matrixWorldInverse);
  face.visible=false;renderer.clippingPlanes=[new THREE.Plane(normal,-center.x-.002)];renderer.setRenderTarget(r.target);renderer.render(scene,virtual);face.material=r.material;
 }catch(e){console.warn('Reflejo planar desactivado',e);mirrorFailed=true;face.material=mMirror;}
 finally{face.visible=true;renderer.clippingPlanes=planes;renderer.setRenderTarget(previous);}
}
function renderArchitecture(force=false){
 if(!webglOK)return;
 updatePlanarReflection(force);
 if((!force&&ST.quality==='fast')||aoDisabled||!renderer.capabilities.isWebGL2){renderer.render(scene,cam);return;}
 try{
  if(!photoAO)photoAO=makeAO();const a=photoAO,w=canvas.width,h=canvas.height;
  if(a.target.width!==w||a.target.height!==h)a.target.setSize(w,h);
  a.uniforms.texel.value.set(1/w,1/h);a.uniforms.invProjection.value.copy(cam.projectionMatrixInverse);a.uniforms.projection.value.copy(cam.projectionMatrix);
  a.uniforms.sampleCount.value=(force||ST.quality==='ultra')?16:8;
  renderer.setRenderTarget(a.target);renderer.render(scene,cam);renderer.setRenderTarget(null);renderer.render(a.postScene,a.camera);
 }catch(e){console.warn('SSAO desactivado; render directo',e);aoDisabled=true;renderer.setRenderTarget(null);renderer.render(scene,cam);}
}
/* ===== Bucle ===== */
function resize(){
 if(photoBusy)return;
 const maxRatio=ST.quality==='ultra'?2.5:ST.quality==='high'?2:1;
 const budget=ST.quality==='ultra'?5500000:ST.quality==='high'?3200000:2200000;
 const maxBudgetRatio=Math.sqrt(budget/Math.max(1,innerWidth*innerHeight));
 const pr=Math.max(.6,Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,maxRatio,maxBudgetRatio));
 renderer.setPixelRatio(pr);renderer.setSize(innerWidth,innerHeight,false);
 cam.aspect=innerWidth/innerHeight;const narrow=innerWidth<=820;cam.fov=narrow?(cam.aspect<1?76:63):(ST.renderStyle==='photo'?53:62);
 if(narrow&&!document.body.classList.contains('sheetmin'))cam.setViewOffset(innerWidth,innerHeight,0,innerHeight*.2,innerWidth,innerHeight);else cam.clearViewOffset();
 cam.updateProjectionMatrix()}
addEventListener('resize',resize);
/* Foto PNG: render a resolución independiente de la pantalla y restaura el visor.
   No incluye el panel, por lo que sirve para mostrar terminaciones a clientes. */
function capturePhoto(){
 if(photoBusy)return;
 if(!webglOK){toast("Exportación 3D no disponible sin WebGL");return;}
 const max=renderer.capabilities.maxTextureSize||4096;
 const aspect=Math.max(.3,innerWidth/Math.max(1,innerHeight));
 const mobile=innerWidth<=820;
 let w=mobile?Math.min(2560,max):Math.min(3840,max);
 let h=Math.round(w/aspect);
 if(h>max){h=max;w=Math.round(h*aspect)}
 if(w*h>10000000){const factor=Math.sqrt(10000000/(w*h));w=Math.round(w*factor);h=Math.round(h*factor)}
 const oldRatio=renderer.getPixelRatio();
 try{
  renderer.setPixelRatio(1);renderer.setSize(w,h,false);
  renderArchitecture();
  const url=canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
  if(url==='data:,')throw new Error('La captura WebGL no pudo leerse');
  const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;
  a.download=`INGEBAM-recorrido-3D-${ST.time}-${w}x${h}.png`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();
  toast(`Fotografía PNG guardada · ${w}×${h}`);
 }catch(err){console.error('Exportación PNG',err);toast('No se pudo exportar; utiliza calidad Alta')}finally{
  renderer.setPixelRatio(oldRatio);resize();
 }
}
/* V10: fotografía con muestreo subpíxel determinista. No cambia ST ni precios. */
async function captureStudio(){
 if(!webglOK||photoBusy){toast('Modo estudio requiere WebGL disponible');return;}
 photoBusy=true;const base=cam.projectionMatrix.clone(),inverse=cam.projectionMatrixInverse.clone(),ratio=renderer.getPixelRatio();
 const overlay=document.createElement('div');overlay.style.cssText='position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100000;background:#151515ac;color:white;display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 16px system-ui';document.body.appendChild(overlay);
 const aspect=cam.aspect,max=renderer.capabilities.maxTextureSize||2048;let w=Math.min(2560,max),h=Math.round(w/aspect);if(h>max){h=max;w=Math.round(h*aspect)}if(w*h>4000000){const k=Math.sqrt(4000000/(w*h));w=Math.floor(w*k);h=Math.floor(h*k)}
 const offsets=[[-.375,-.125],[.125,-.375],[.375,.125],[-.125,.375],[-.375,.375],[.375,-.375],[-.125,-.125],[.125,.125]];
 try{
  const result=mk(w,h),ctx=result.getContext('2d');renderer.setPixelRatio(1);renderer.setSize(w,h,false);
  for(let i=0;i<offsets.length;i++){
   overlay.textContent=`Generando fotografía · muestra ${i+1}/8`;
   await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,0));if(!webglOK)throw Error('Contexto perdido');
   cam.projectionMatrix.copy(base);cam.projectionMatrix.elements[8]+=2*offsets[i][0]/w;cam.projectionMatrix.elements[9]+=2*offsets[i][1]/h;cam.projectionMatrixInverse.copy(cam.projectionMatrix).invert();
   renderArchitecture(true);ctx.globalAlpha=1/(i+1);ctx.drawImage(canvas,0,0,w,h);
  }
  const blob=await new Promise(resolve=>result.toBlob(resolve,'image/png'));if(!blob)throw Error('PNG no disponible');
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=`INGEBAM-Estudio-${w}x${h}.png`;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),30000);toast('Fotografía Estudio exportada');
 }catch(e){console.error(e);toast('No se pudo generar Estudio; prueba la captura estándar');}
 finally{cam.projectionMatrix.copy(base);cam.projectionMatrixInverse.copy(inverse);renderer.setPixelRatio(ratio);photoBusy=false;resize();overlay.remove();}
}
let last=performance.now(),tt=0,bob=0,first=true;
function frame(now){
 requestAnimationFrame(frame);if(photoBusy){last=now;return;}const dt=Math.min(.05,(now-last)/1000);last=now;tt+=dt;
 let f=0,s=0;if(keys.KeyW||keys.ArrowUp)f++;if(keys.KeyS||keys.ArrowDown)f--;if(keys.KeyD)s++;if(keys.KeyA)s--;
 f-=joyV.y;s+=joyV.x;if(keys.ArrowLeft)P.yaw+=1.6*dt;if(keys.ArrowRight)P.yaw-=1.6*dt;
 const l=Math.hypot(f,s);if(l>.05){const sp=(keys.ShiftLeft||keys.ShiftRight?3:1.5)*dt/Math.max(1,l);
  const sy=Math.sin(P.yaw),cy=Math.cos(P.yaw);tryMove((-sy*f+cy*s)*sp,(-cy*f-sy*s)*sp);bob+=dt*7}
 cam.position.set(P.x,EYE+Math.sin(bob)*.012*Math.min(1,l),P.z);cam.rotation.set(P.pitch,P.yaw,0);
 if(flames&&gFire.visible){flames.children.forEach((c,i)=>{c.scale.y=.8+.35*Math.sin(tt*9+i*1.7)*Math.sin(tt*5.3+i);c.scale.x=c.scale.z=.9+.15*Math.sin(tt*7+i)});fireLight.intensity=(ST.time==='night'?1.5:.7)*(.85+.15*Math.sin(tt*11))}
 if(webglOK){try{renderArchitecture()}catch(error){console.error(error);reportFallback('El render 3D no pudo continuar. Prueba Chrome o Edge con aceleración gráfica.')}}
 drawMap();
 if(!webglOK){const out=document.getElementById('fallbackPlan');const ctx=out.getContext('2d');ctx.clearRect(0,0,out.width,out.height);ctx.drawImage(mapc,0,0,out.width,out.height);}
 if(first){first=false;$('#load').classList.add('off')}
}
goto(ROOMS[0]);try{apply()}catch(error){console.error(error);reportFallback('No se pudo inicializar el render 3D. El plano y el panel comercial siguen disponibles.')}updateTotals();renderTab();
if(!webglOK)reportFallback('WebGL no está disponible en este navegador. Abre el archivo descargado en Chrome o Edge con aceleración gráfica activada.');
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
window.__dbg={P,ST,quote,apply,goto,ROOMS,renderer,capturePhoto,surfaceMaps,version:'Motor arquitectónico 10.3',photoAssets:Object.keys(PHOTO_FILES)};
</script>

  html=layout('Cotizaciones','Historial inalterable de precios y configuraciones al momento de guardar cada propuesta',btn('+ Nueva cotización','quote-new','', 'primary'),list.length?`<section class="biz-card"><div class="biz-tablewrap"><table class="biz-table"><thead><tr><th>Folio / Fecha</th><th>Cliente y proyecto</th><th>Total</th><th>Estado</th><th>Acciones</th></tr></thead><tbody>${list.map(q=>`<tr><td><b>${esc(q.folio)}</b><br><span class="biz-muted">${esc(q.date)}</span></td><td><b>${esc(q.clientName)}</b><br><span class="biz-muted">${esc(q.projectName)}</span></td><td><b>${fmt(q.total)}</b></td><td><select data-quote-status="${esc(q.id)}" aria-label="Estado de ${esc(q.folio)}">${['Borrador','Enviada','Aceptada','Rechazada'].map(s=>`<option ${q.status===s?'selected':''}>${s}</option>`).join('')}</select></td><td><div class="biz-actions wrap">${btn('Ver / PDF','quote-print',q.id,'primary')}${btn('Eliminar','quote-delete',q.id,'quiet')}</div></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div></section>`:none('No hay cotizaciones. Configura materiales en el visor y selecciona “Nueva cotización”.'));
 }
 else if(state.tab==='empresa'){
  const c=db.company;
  html=layout('Mi empresa','Identidad comercial y parámetros de cálculo usados en las nuevas cotizaciones',btn('Guardar empresa','company-save','','primary'),`<section class="biz-card biz-formmax"><div class="biz-formgrid"><label>Razón social / Nombre comercial<input data-company="name" value="${esc(c.name)}" required></label><label>RUT de empresa<input data-company="rut" value="${esc(c.rut||'')}" placeholder="76.123.456-7"></label><label>Correo comercial<input data-company="email" type="email" value="${esc(c.email||'')}" placeholder="contacto@empresa.cl"></label><label>Teléfono<input data-company="phone" value="${esc(c.phone||'')}" placeholder="+56 9 ..."></label><label class="wide">Dirección<input data-company="address" value="${esc(c.address||'')}"></label></div><h2>Configuración de precios</h2><div class="biz-formgrid"><label>Gastos indirectos (%)<input data-company="overheadPct" type="number" min="0" max="100" step="0.1" value="${c.overheadPct}"></label><label>Margen comercial (%)<input data-company="marginPct" type="number" min="0" max="100" step="0.1" value="${c.marginPct}"></label><label>IVA (%)<input data-company="ivaPct" type="number" min="0" max="100" step="0.1" value="${c.ivaPct}"></label><label class="biz-check"><input data-company="applyIVA" type="checkbox" ${c.applyIVA?'checked':''}><span>Aplicar IVA a las cotizaciones</span></label></div><p class="biz-notice">Revisa el tratamiento tributario y el precio de venta correspondiente a tu actividad antes de enviar una propuesta real. No se ha verificado ninguna tasa ni obligación tributaria de la empresa.</p></section>`)
 }
 else if(state.tab==='datos'){
  html=layout('Respaldo y datos','Protege la información de trabajo guardando una copia local',btn('Exportar respaldo JSON','data-export','','primary')+btn('Importar respaldo JSON','data-import'),`<div class="biz-split"><section class="biz-card"><h2>Almacenamiento de este MVP</h2><p>La información permanece en <b>este navegador y en este equipo</b>. No se sincroniza con servidores ni se comparte entre vendedores.</p><p class="biz-muted">Clientes, proyectos y cotizaciones se conservarán al recargar la página siempre que no elimines los datos del navegador.</p><div class="biz-actions">${btn('Exportar clientes CSV','clients-csv')}${btn('Exportar cotizaciones CSV','quotes-csv')}</div></section><section class="biz-card"><h2>Próxima versión en servidor</h2><p>Para trabajar con varias personas hay que agregar autenticación, permisos, base de datos, respaldos automáticos y aislamiento por empresa.</p><p class="biz-notice">No utilices este MVP local para información personal sensible o para gestión productiva sin respaldo y controles de acceso.</p><div class="biz-actions">${btn('Restablecer datos de demostración','demo-reset','','quiet')}</div></section></div><input id="biz-import" type="file" accept="application/json,.json" hidden>`)
 }
 document.getElementById('biz-main').innerHTML=(state.storageOK?'':'<p class="biz-notice"><b>Guardado deshabilitado:</b> este navegador no permite conservar información entre sesiones. Exporta un respaldo JSON antes de cerrar.</p>')+html;
}
function open(){document.getElementById('biz-overlay').classList.add('is-open');document.getElementById('biz-overlay').setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');render()}
function close(){document.getElementById('biz-overlay').classList.remove('is-open');document.getElementById('biz-overlay').setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');document.getElementById('biz-modal').classList.remove('is-open')}
function nav(tab){state.tab=tab;render()}
function modal(title,content,submit,confirm='Guardar'){
 const d=document.getElementById('biz-modal');
 d.innerHTML=`<div class="biz-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${esc(title)}"><div class="biz-dialoghead"><h2>${esc(title)}</h2><button aria-label="Cerrar" type="button" data-action="modal-close">✕</button></div><form id="biz-dialog-form"><div class="biz-dialogbody">${content}</div><div class="biz-dialogbuttons"><button class="biz-btn" type="button" data-action="modal-close">Cancelar</button><button class="biz-btn primary" type="submit">${esc(confirm)}</button></div></form></div>`;
 d.classList.add('is-open');
 document.getElementById('biz-dialog-form').addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();const fd=new FormData(e.currentTarget);if(submit(fd)!==false){d.classList.remove('is-open');render()}});
 d.querySelector('input:not([type=hidden]),select,textarea')?.focus();
}
const field=(name,label,value='',required=false,attr='')=>`<label>${esc(label)}<input name="${name}" value="${esc(value)}" ${required?'required':''} ${attr}></label>`;
const select=(name,label,items,value='')=>`<label>${esc(label)}<select name="${name}">${items.map(([id,name])=>`<option value="${esc(id)}" ${id===value?'selected':''}>${esc(name)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>`;
function projectForm(record){
 const p=record||{title:'',location:'',description:'',basePriceM2:890000,clientId:'',status:'En preparación'};
 modal(record?'Editar proyecto':'Crear proyecto',`<p class="biz-formhint">Este MVP utiliza únicamente la geometría del departamento Torre Alameda 14B (75 m²).</p><div class="biz-formgrid">${field('title','Nombre del proyecto',p.title,true,'maxlength="90"')}${field('location','Ubicación',p.location,false,'maxlength="120"')}${field('basePriceM2','Precio base CLP por m²',p.basePriceM2,true,'type="number" min="1" step="1"')}${select('status','Estado',[['En preparación','En preparación'],['En venta','En venta'],['Finalizado','Finalizado']],p.status)}${select('clientId','Cliente principal',[['','Sin asignar'],...state.db.clients.map(c=>[c.id,c.name])],p.clientId)}</div><label>Descripción<textarea name="description" rows="3" maxlength="400">${esc(p.description)}</textarea></label>`,fd=>{
  const base=Number(fd.get('basePriceM2'));if(!Number.isFinite(base)||base<=0)return false;
  if(record)Object.assign(record,{title:text(fd.get('title')).trim(),location:text(fd.get('location')).trim(),description:text(fd.get('description')).trim(),status:text(fd.get('status')),clientId:text(fd.get('clientId')),basePriceM2:Math.round(base),updatedAt:now()});
  else {const x={id:id('prj'),title:text(fd.get('title')).trim(),location:text(fd.get('location')).trim(),description:text(fd.get('description')).trim(),status:text(fd.get('status')),clientId:text(fd.get('clientId')),basePriceM2:Math.round(base),model:'alameda14b',area:75,config:{...DEF},createdAt:now(),updatedAt:now()};state.db.projects.unshift(x);state.db.activeProjectId=x.id;syncVisual()}
  save();refreshQuote();notice('Proyecto guardado');
 });
}
function clientForm(record){
 const c=record||{name:'',company:'',email:'',phone:'',notes:''};
 modal(record?'Editar cliente':'Nuevo cliente',`<div class="biz-formgrid">${field('name','Nombre del cliente',c.name,true,'maxlength="100"')}${field('company','Empresa',c.company,false,'maxlength="100"')}${field('email','Correo electrónico',c.email,false,'type="email" maxlength="120"')}${field('phone','Teléfono / WhatsApp',c.phone,false,'maxlength="50"')}</div><label>Observaciones<textarea name="notes" rows="3" maxlength="500">${esc(c.notes)}</textarea></label>`,fd=>{
  const obj={name:text(fd.get('name')).trim(),company:text(fd.get('company')).trim(),email:text(fd.get('email')).trim(),phone:text(fd.get('phone')).trim(),notes:text(fd.get('notes')).trim()};
  if(!obj.name)return false;
  if(record){Object.assign(record,obj);state.db.quotes.forEach(q=>{if(q.clientId===record.id&&q.status==='Borrador')q.clientName=obj.name})}else state.db.clients.push({id:id('cli'),...obj,createdAt:now()});
  save();notice('Cliente guardado');
 });
}
function quoteForm(){
 if(!state.db.clients.length){nav('clientes');clientForm(null);notice('Primero registra un cliente');return}
 const p=active();
 modal('Crear propuesta comercial',`<div class="biz-formgrid">${select('clientId','Cliente',state.db.clients.map(c=>[c.id,c.name]),p.clientId||state.db.clients[0].id)}${field('validDays','Vigencia de la propuesta (días)',15,true,'type="number" min="1" max="365"')}</div><label>Observaciones para el cliente<textarea name="notes" rows="4" maxlength="900" placeholder="Plazos, exclusiones, condiciones comerciales…"></textarea></label><p class="biz-formhint">El sistema guarda una fotografía de precios y configuración actuales. Los cambios posteriores al catálogo no alterarán esta cotización.</p>`,fd=>{
  const client=state.db.clients.find(c=>c.id===fd.get('clientId'));if(!client)return false;
  const q=computed();const seq=state.db.seq++;
  state.db.quotes.push({id:id('quo'),folio:'ING-'+new Date().getFullYear()+'-'+String(seq).padStart(4,'0'),date:today(),createdAt:now(),validDays:Number(fd.get('validDays'))||15,notes:text(fd.get('notes')).trim(),status:'Borrador',clientId:client.id,clientName:client.name,clientEmail:client.email,clientPhone:client.phone,projectId:p.id,projectName:p.title,projectLocation:p.location,company:{...state.db.company},config:{...ST},quote:{...q},total:q.total});
  save();state.tab='cotizaciones';notice('Cotización guardada');
 },'Guardar cotización');
}
function priceSave(){const inputs=[...document.querySelectorAll('#biz-main [data-price]')],next={...state.db.priceOverrides};for(const input of inputs){const v=Number(input.value);if(input.value.trim()===''||!Number.isFinite(v)||v<0||!Number.isSafeInteger(Math.round(v))){notice('Revisa los valores del catálogo: no se permiten celdas vacías ni negativas');input.focus();return}next[input.dataset.price]=Math.round(v)}state.db.priceOverrides=next;save();refreshQuote();render();notice('Catálogo actualizado')}
function companySave(){const c=state.db.company;document.querySelectorAll('#biz-main [data-company]').forEach(n=>{const k=n.dataset.company;c[k]=n.type==='checkbox'?n.checked:n.type==='number'?Math.max(0,Number(n.value)||0):n.value.trim()});save();refreshQuote();render();notice('Datos de empresa guardados')}
function removeClient(id){if(state.db.quotes.some(q=>q.clientId===id)){notice('No elimines clientes con cotizaciones: conserva el historial');return}if(confirm('¿Eliminar este cliente?')){state.db.clients=state.db.clients.filter(c=>c.id!==id);save();render()}}
function removeProject(id){if(state.db.quotes.some(q=>q.projectId===id)){notice('No se puede eliminar un proyecto que tiene cotizaciones');return}if(state.db.projects.length<=1){notice('Se requiere al menos un proyecto');return}if(confirm('¿Eliminar este proyecto y su configuración?')){state.db.projects=state.db.projects.filter(p=>p.id!==id);if(state.db.activeProjectId===id){state.db.activeProjectId=state.db.projects[0].id;syncVisual()}save();render()}}
function exportData(){download('ingebam-inmo3d-respaldo-'+today()+'.json',JSON.stringify(state.db,null,2),'application/json')}
function download(name,body,mime){const b=new Blob([body],{type:mime+';charset=utf-8'}),u=URL.createObjectURL(b),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=u;a.download=name;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u),3000)}
function csvExport(rows,name){if(!rows.length){notice('No hay registros para exportar');return}const keys=Object.keys(rows[0]);const q=v=>'"'+text(v).replace(/"/g,'""')+'"';const csv='\ufeff'+keys.map(q).join(';')+'\n'+rows.map(r=>keys.map(k=>q(r[k])).join(';')).join('\n');download(name+'.csv',csv,'text/csv')}
function quotePrint(id){const q=state.db.quotes.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!q)return;
 const c=q.company||state.db.company,details=q.quote,terms=details.upg||[];
 const html=`<!doctype html><html lang="es"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>${esc(q.folio)} · #e8e8e3;padding:9px 10px;vertical-align:top}.total td{font-size:17px;font-weight:bold;border-top:2px solid #9b713d}.sum td{font-weight:bold}.muted{color:#777;font-size:11px}.note{padding:13px;background:#f6f6f2;border-left:3px solid #b58d57;margin:22px 0}.tools{padding:10px 0;margin-bottom:15px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd}.tools button{background:#24292b;color:white;padding:9px 15px;border:0;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer}@media print{.tools{display:none}}</style></head><body><div class="tools"><button onclick="print()">Imprimir / guardar como PDF</button></div><header><div><div class="brand">${esc(c.name||'INGEBAM')}</div><small>${esc(c.rut||'')} · ${esc(c.address||'')}</small><small>${esc(c.email||'')} ${esc(c.phone||'')}</small></div><div style="text-align:right"><h1>COTIZACIÓN</h1><b>${esc(q.folio)}</b><small>Fecha: ${esc(q.date)} · Vigencia: ${esc(q.validDays)} días</small></div></header><div class="meta"><div><b>Cliente</b><br>${esc(q.clientName)}<br>${esc(q.clientEmail||'')}<br>${esc(q.clientPhone||'')}</div><div><b>Proyecto</b><br>${esc(q.projectName)}<br>${esc(q.projectLocation||'')}<br>Modelo class="muted">'+esc(u.d)+'</small>':''}</td><td>${fmt(u.v)}</td></tr>`).join('')}<tr class="sum"><td>Subtotal</td><td>${fmt(details.subtotal)}</td></tr>${details.overhead?`<tr><td>Gastos function handleAction(action,id){const db=state.db;switch(action){
 case 'open':open();break;case 'close':close();break;case 'modal-close':document.getElementById('biz-modal').classList.remove('is-open');break;
 case 'nav':nav(id);break;case 'project-new':projectForm();break;case 'project-edit':projectForm(db.projects.find(x=>x.id===id));break;
 case 'project-activate':db.activeProjectId=id;save();syncVisual();render();notice('Proyecto activo en el visor');break;
 case 'project-duplicate':{const p=db.projects.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!p)return;const x={...p,id:idFn('prj'),title:p.title+' · Copia',config:{...p.config},createdAt:now(),updatedAt:now()};db.projects.unshift(x);db.activeProjectId=x.id;save();syncVisual();render();break}
 case 'project-delete':removeProject(id);break;
 case 'client-new':clientForm();break;case 'client-edit':clientForm(db.clients.find(x=>x.id===id));break;case 'client-delete':removeClient(id);break;
 case 'quote-new':quoteForm();break;case 'quote-print':quotePrint(id);break;
 case 'quote-delete':if(confirm('¿Eliminar esta cotización del historial?')){db.quotes=db.quotes.filter(q=>q.id!==id);save();render()}break;
 case 'price-save':priceSave();break;case 'price-reset':if(confirm('¿Restablecer todos los precios referenciales?')){db.priceOverrides={};save();refreshQuote();render()}break;
 case 'company-save':companySave();break;
 case 'data-export':exportData();break;case 'data-import':document.getElementById('biz-import').click();break;
 case 'clients-csv':csvExport(db.clients.map(c=>({Nombre:c.name,Empresa:c.company,Correo:c.email,Telefono:c.phone,Notas:c.notes})),'ingebam-clientes');break;
 case 'quotes-csv':csvExport(db.quotes.map(q=>({Folio:q.folio,Fecha:q.date,Cliente:q.clientName,Proyecto:q.projectName,Total_CLP:q.total,Estado:q.status})),'ingebam-cotizaciones');break;
 case 'demo-reset':if(confirm('Se borrarán los datos locales de INGEBAM Inmo3D Empresas. ¿Continuar?')){state.db=initial();save();syncVisual();nav('resumen')}break;
 }}
const idFn=id;
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-action]');if(b){e.preventDefault();handleAction(b.dataset.action,b.dataset.id)}});
document.addEventListener('change',async e=>{
 const n=e.target;
 if(n.dataset.quoteStatus){const q=state.db.quotes.find(q=>q.id===n.dataset.quoteStatus);if(q){q.status=n.value;save();render();notice('Estado actualizado')}}
 if(n.id==='biz-import'&&n.files?.length){try{const data=JSON.parse(await n.files[0].text());if(!validDb(data))throw Error('Formato de respaldo incompleto o incorrecto');if(!confirm('¿Reemplazar los datos locales por este respaldo?'))return;state.db=data;state.db.activeProjectId=data.projects.some(p=>p.id===data.activeProjectId)?data.activeProjectId:data.projects[0].id;save();syncVisual();nav('resumen');notice('Datos importados')}catch(err){alert('No fue posible importar el respaldo: '+err.message)}finally{n.value=''}}
});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){const d=document.getElementById('biz-modal');if(d.classList.contains('is-open'))d.classList.remove('is-open');else if(document.getElementById('biz-overlay').classList.contains('is-open'))close()}});

state.db=read();if(!state.db.projects.length)state.db=initial();
state.db.activeProjectId=active().id;
window.INMO_BUSINESS={getActiveProject:active,getBasePriceM2:()=>active()?.basePriceM2||890000,getPrice:priced,getSettings:settings,onVisualConfigChange,computed,getDb:()=>state.db};
save();syncVisual();syncHeader();
if(!state.storageOK)notice('Almacenamiento local deshabilitado: exporta tu trabajo');
if(typeof change!=='function'){const loader=document.getElementById('load');if(loader){loader.textContent='El visor WebGL no pudo iniciarse. Puedes abrir Gestión empresarial.';loader.style.pointerEvents='none';loader.style.opacity='.8';loader.style.inset='auto auto 15px 15px';loader.style.maxWidth='300px';loader.style.padding='12px';loader.style.borderRadius='10px'}}
})();
